results.title: ttnn.where rounds Python-int scalars through float32 for int32/uint32 tensors (wrong values for |s| > 2^24; INT32_MAX/UINT32_MAX rejected)
results.author: jerryfane
results.body_snippet: ## Summary `ttnn.where` with an **int32 or uint32** tensor and a **Python `int` scalar** silently rounds the scalar through `float32`. Any scalar with |s| > 2²⁴ that isn't exactly representable in fp32 comes back changed, with no error. `ttnn.add(int32, s)` keeps the same scalar exact, and so does `torch.where`. A second symptom: `INT32_MAX` and `UINT32_MAX` are valid scalars, but they are **rejected** by the range check, because the check runs on the already-rounded float (2³¹ / 2³²). ## Repro

results.body_snippet: 版本：0.1.2（e55636c）。 本地 stub 对 `tools/call query` 只收不答。触发 20 次补搜后等 8 秒：服务端挂着 20 条请求、20 条连接，插件 0 条 warn。 `mcpRequest` 里的 `fetch`（`index.js:49`）没有传 `signal`，只能等 Node 内置 fetch 的默认超时（大约 300 秒，这一条未实测）。如果挂起的是 `status`，`loadTriggerRoots` 的 `rootsLoading` 一直不清，之后所有触发都排在它后面。 建议：`fetch(url, { …, signal: AbortSignal.timeout(5000) })`，超时也按「下次重试」走 warn。 --- 独立测评记录（含全部读数与复现脚本清单）：FuRongJun-1999/dsh-bounty#1323

results.title: [75/100] Synchronous Regular Expression Evaluation in Log Alert Engine
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/services/log_alerts.rs:40-90 • Severity: Medium • Description: Evaluating log alert trigger conditions recompiles and evaluates regular expressions synchronously across every incoming log record, consuming significant CPU cycles. • Remediation: Pre-compile regex patterns with regex::RegexSet and evaluate log streams asynchronously on dedicated worker threads.

results.title: [83/100] Cache Pre-Warming Worker Queries Entire Contract Database Without Pagination
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/workers/cache_warm.rs:30-70 • Severity: Medium • Description: The cache warming worker executes a SELECT * FROM contracts query without a LIMIT or cursor, causing query timeouts and huge memory spikes on production databases with thousands of contracts. • Remediation: Implement cursor-based keyset pagination in the cache pre-warming worker.

results.title: [84/100] Job History Automated Pruning Locks Job Runs Table
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/workers/job_history.rs:35-75 • Severity: Medium • Description: Pruning expired job run records uses DELETE FROM job_runs WHERE finished_at < NOW() - INTERVAL '30 days' in a single unbounded query, taking exclusive table locks and blocking active job insertions. • Remediation: Execute deletions in bounded batches (e.g. DELETE in chunks of 1,000 with a sleep) or migrate job_runs to partitioned tables.

results.title: [85/100] Low Priority Task Queue Starvation Under Continuous High Priority Load
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/workers/priority.rs:40-85 • Severity: Medium • Description: The priority task scheduler strictly drains the high-priority queue before inspecting medium or low queues. Sustained high-priority workloads indefinitely starve lower-priority background tasks. • Remediation: Implement a weighted fair queuing algorithm (e.g. 70% high, 20% medium, 10% low) to guarantee forward progress for lower priority jobs.

results.title: [89/100] Database Connection Acquire Timeout Too High Causing Request Stalls
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/config/database.rs:25-50 • Severity: Medium • Description: Database connection acquisition timeout is set to 30 seconds. When the database pool is exhausted, incoming HTTP requests stall for 30 seconds before failing, causing cascading frontend timeouts. • Remediation: Reduce connection acquire timeout to 3-5 seconds and return an immediate 503 Service Unavailable when the pool is saturated.

results.title: [90/100] Missing TCP Keepalive on PostgreSQL Connection Pool
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/config/database.rs:55-80 • Severity: Medium • Description: SQLx PgPool configuration does not configure TCP keepalive probes. Intermediate cloud firewalls and NAT gateways silently drop idle connections, causing subsequent queries to hang until TCP timeout. • Remediation: Configure PgPoolOptions with tcp_keepalive(Some(Duration::from_secs(60))).

results.title: [96/100] Input Sanitizer Stripper Misses Unicode Control and Zero-Width Characters
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/config/sanitize.rs:40-85 • Severity: Low • Description: sanitize_input removes ASCII control characters and HTML tags, but does not strip Unicode bidirectional override characters (U+202E) or zero-width joiners that can be used for visual spoofing. • Remediation: Add Unicode normalization (NFKC) and strip zero-width and bidirectional control codepoints in input sanitization routines.

results.title: [98/100] Redis Health Check Reports Healthy When Node is in Read-Only Loading State
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/db/redis.rs:25-50 • Severity: Medium • Description: The health probe checks Redis by executing PING, which succeeds even when the Redis replica is in loading state or read-only mode during cluster recovery. • Remediation: Verify write capability or inspect Redis INFO persistence/replication status flags during readiness health checks.

results.title: [87/100] Dead-Letter Queue Replay Lacks Jitter Leading to Synchronized Retry Waves
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/workers/retry.rs:60-105 • Severity: Medium • Description: Bulk-replaying dead-letter jobs schedules all retries with identical delay timers, overwhelming downstream external APIs with synchronized thundering herd spikes. • Remediation: Introduce randomized jitter into bulk DLQ retry scheduling.

results.title: [88/100] Overly Permissive CORS Configuration in Non-Production Environments
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/config/cors.rs:15-35 • Severity: Medium • Description: cors.rs defaults to AllowOrigin::any() and allows credentials when environment is not set to production, exposing developer and staging setups to cross-origin credential theft. • Remediation: Explicitly reject AllowOrigin::any() in combination with allow_credentials(true) across all environments.

results.title: [71/100] gRPC Server Lacks Keepalive and Maximum Connection Age Configuration
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/services/grpc.rs:30-65 • Severity: Medium • Description: Tonic gRPC server initialization omits keepalive ping intervals, connection timeouts, and max connection age, leading to stale dead connections persisting through infrastructure load balancers. • Remediation: Configure http2_keepalive_interval, http2_keepalive_timeout, and max_connection_age on the Tonic Server builder.

results.title: [77/100] Security Scanner Does Not Validate WASM Section Header Offsets
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/services/security_scanner.rs:40-85 • Severity: High • Description: Disassembling WASM binaries for unsafe instructions parses raw byte offsets without validating section lengths, causing panics on truncated or malformed WebAssembly files. • Remediation: Validate all WebAssembly section boundaries and payload sizes using wasmparser::Parser before attempting instruction extraction.

results.title: [51/100] Bytecode Vulnerability Scanner Relies on Naive Byte Pattern Matching
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/services/vulnerability_scanner.rs:54-88 • Severity: High • Description: scan_bytecode flags reentrancy, unchecked arithmetic, and uninitialized storage by checking if arbitrary raw bytes (such as 0x54, which is the standard i32.wrap_i64 WASM opcode) appear anywhere in the binary, causing massive false positives on benign contracts. • Remediation: Replace raw byte slice matching with proper WebAssembly AST parsing using wasmparser to inspect instructions in their semantic

results.title: [58/100] Synchronous Contract Invocation Logging Blocks Request Pipeline
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/services/contract_call_logger.rs:40-80 • Severity: High • Description: Contract call logger executes direct database writes synchronously during HTTP request handling, causing request latencies to spike under high-frequency contract interaction loads. • Remediation: Buffer contract invocation logs in a bounded crossbeam/mpsc channel and flush them in batches via an asynchronous background worker.

results.title: [60/100] Contract Metadata Registry Overwrite Lacks Ownership Authorization
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/services/contract_registry.rs:30-65 • Severity: High • Description: Registering or updating contract metadata in the registry does not verify whether the caller holds administrative privileges or original deployer rights for the specified contract ID. • Remediation: Enforce deployer signature verification or organization-level permission checks prior to modifying contract registry records.

results.title: [69/100] Unsanitized Markdown in Contract Documentation Generator Renders XSS
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/services/doc_generator.rs:90-130 • Severity: High • Description: Docstrings extracted from uploaded contract source code are rendered directly into OpenAPI description fields without HTML escaping, enabling Stored XSS attacks in Swagger UI. • Remediation: Pass all extracted docstrings through an HTML sanitization filter (such as ammonia) before embedding them into OpenAPI schema documentation.

results.title: [72/100] Unbounded Inbound Message Size on gRPC Contract Streaming Endpoint
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/services/grpc.rs:70-100 • Severity: High • Description: The gRPC contract deployment stream does not set max_decoding_message_size, allowing malicious clients to stream oversized byte buffers and trigger out-of-memory crashes. • Remediation: Enforce a 10MB max_decoding_message_size limit on the gRPC contract service.

results.title: [66/100] Compliance Sanction Verification Blocks Without Request Timeout
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/services/compliance.rs:30-70 • Severity: High • Description: Calling the external compliance / OFAC verification service relies on default HTTP client settings without an explicit request timeout, hanging caller threads if the upstream compliance API hangs. • Remediation: Wrap compliance checks in a strict 3-second timeout with fallback to temporary manual-review queues.

results.title: [76/100] Deployment Rollback Engine Does Not Restore Contract Temporary Storage
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/services/rollback.rs:35-85 • Severity: High • Description: The rollback service restores contract WASM bytecode and instance storage, but does not revert temporary or persistent storage entries modified by failed migration scripts. • Remediation: Include complete snapshotting of contract storage keyspaces prior to upgrades and restore all storage tiers on rollback.

results.title: [81/100] Task Execution Worker Silently Discards Panics Without Diagnostic Trace
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/workers/executor.rs:40-85 • Severity: High • Description: Background task execution handles tokio::task::JoinError by marking the job as failed, but does not extract or log the panic payload or backtrace, hindering debugging of worker crashes. • Remediation: Use std::panic::catch_unwind or join_error.into_panic() to extract and persist the panic message and backtrace into the failed job record.

results.title: [82/100] Missing Per-Task Timeout Enforcement in Background Worker Executor
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/workers/executor.rs:90-130 • Severity: High • Description: Background jobs run indefinitely without an upper execution deadline. If a worker gets stuck in an infinite network wait or deadlocked mutex, worker concurrency slots are leaked permanently. • Remediation: Enforce a configurable per-job timeout (e.g., 5 minutes) via tokio::time::timeout on all executor tasks.

results.title: [70/100] Error Recovery Manager Lacks Exponential Backoff for Persistent Failures
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/services/error_recovery.rs:25-70 • Severity: Medium • Description: Tasks flagged for automatic error recovery are retried immediately on fixed intervals, rapidly consuming system resources when an external dependency is down. • Remediation: Implement truncated exponential backoff with jitter for all automated task recovery attempts.

results.title: [73/100] High Cardinality Route Dimensions in HTTP Metrics Prometheus Collector
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/services/http_metrics.rs:20-60 • Severity: Medium • Description: The HTTP metrics middleware includes raw request paths with un-parameterized dynamic UUID path segments in Prometheus metric labels, causing unbounded time-series cardinality explosion. • Remediation: Normalize URL paths to their route pattern templates (e.g. /api/v1/contracts/:id) before recording Prometheus metrics.

results.title: [74/100] Log Aggregator Channel Drops Warning Logs Under Burst Traffic
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/services/log_aggregator.rs:25-60 • Severity: Medium • Description: The log aggregation channel uses try_send with a small buffer, silently discarding warning and error log entries during traffic surges without recording dropped message counters. • Remediation: Increase channel capacity and maintain an atomic dropped_logs_total metric counter when buffer backpressure occurs.

results.title: [91/100] Redis Connection Manager Does Not Reconnect on Initial Startup Failure
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/config/redis.rs:20-55 • Severity: High • Description: If Redis is booting up or temporarily unreachable during backend startup, redis::Client::get_connection_manager fails immediately and aborts the entire application without retrying. • Remediation: Wrap initial Redis connection manager creation in an exponential retry loop with a configurable startup timeout.

results.title: [92/100] HTTP/2 Server Listener Lacks Max Concurrent Streams Bound
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/config/server.rs:30-65 • Severity: High • Description: The Axum HTTP listener does not restrict HTTP/2 max concurrent streams, allowing an attacker to open thousands of concurrent HTTP/2 streams over a single TCP connection (HTTP/2 Rapid Reset vulnerability). • Remediation: Configure http2_max_concurrent_streams(Some(100)) on the Hyper server builder.

results.title: [93/100] Server Graceful Shutdown Does Not Drain Background Worker Jobs
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/config/server.rs:70-110 • Severity: High • Description: Receiving a SIGTERM triggers Axum graceful shutdown for HTTP requests, but background workers and scheduled ingestion loops are terminated abruptly, leaving in-flight jobs in a half-committed state. • Remediation: Broadcast a shutdown cancellation token to all background workers and await worker termination before exiting the process.

results.title: [1/50] Blocking Thread Pool Starvation on Sandbox Execution Timeout
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/api/handlers/sandbox.rs:31-80 • Severity: Critical • Description: When a contract execution times out in tokio::time::timeout, the underlying tokio::task::spawn_blocking task cannot be cancelled. Untrusted Soroban WASM contracts executing infinite loops permanently monopolize blocking worker threads, quickly leading to complete thread pool exhaustion and API server deadlock. • Remediation: Execute WASM sandboxes inside bounded child processes or pass an atomic cancellatio

results.title: [19/50] Path Traversal Vulnerability in LCOV Coverage Report Ingestion
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/api/handlers/coverage.rs:25-75 • Severity: Critical • Description: The code coverage report parser extracts source file paths from SF: lines in uploaded LCOV files without sanitizing ../ directory traversal sequences, potentially mapping file paths outside the project workspace. • Remediation: Canonicalize and sanitize parsed source file paths against the repository root using safe path prefix validation.

results.title: [27/50] Tenant Isolation Bypass in Bitmask Permission Checks
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/api/middleware/permissions.rs:30-75 • Severity: Critical • Description: The permission evaluation middleware checks whether an authenticated user possesses the required permission bitmask, but does not cross-reference the target organization/tenant ID against the resource URI, allowing cross-tenant data access. • Remediation: Enforce tenant ownership validation alongside permission bitmask checks in check_permission.

results.title: [68/100] Documentation Generator Crashes on Complex Unnamed Tuple Struct Returns
results.author: ACodehunter
results.body_snippet: • Location: backend/src/services/doc_generator.rs:40-85 • Severity: Medium • Description: The OpenAPI / markdown documentation generator panics when parsing Soroban function return signatures containing deeply nested unnamed tuple structures. • Remediation: Implement robust recursive AST visitors in doc_generator that gracefully format tuple structs and complex enum variants.

results.body_snippet: ### What problem does this solve? Currently, installation may require manual dependency setup and command-line steps, which increases friction for end users.
